summary.text: Philip Baruth, a Democrat/Progressive from Burlington, has represented the Chittenden-Central district in the Vermont Senate since 2011 and serves as President Pro Tempore of the Senate.
He sits on the Senate Committees on Appropriations and Judiciary and chairs the Senate Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: Baruth was originally elected to the Senate in 2010 and has since served on the Education, Economic Development, Judiciary and Agriculture Committees, according to his Senate biography.
He served four years as Senate Majority Leader.

He has taught in the English Department at the University of Vermont since 1993, specializing in Creative Writing, Postmodern American Literature and Culture, Eighteenth-Century British Literature and Vermont Literature.
Before 2010 he spent a dozen years as a commentator for Vermont Public Radio and he has written novels, including The X President, a New York Times Notable Book in 2003.
